explanations:
问年龄固定用 `How old`。常见错误：
• "How age are you?" → 错，age 是名词不能这样问
• "What old are you?" → 疑问词用 How

`are you` 是主谓倒装。常见错误：
• "How old you are?" → 语序没倒装，这种语序只用在宾语从句里（I know how old you are.）

items.sentence: I'm five feet three inches tall.

sentenceAudio.text: I'm five feet three inches tall.

explanations:
`enjoy + 动名词` 是固定用法（enjoy doing）。常见错误：
• "Do you enjoy **to watch**" → enjoy 后必须接 doing，不接 to do
• "I **am enjoying** watch" → 进行时虽可，但宾语仍用 watching
`movies` 美语常用复数指代「电影」这种娱乐形式；单数 a movie 指具体一部影片。

`be good at + 名词/动名词` 表示擅长。常见错误：
• "I'm good **in** cooking" → 搭配是 at，不是 in
• "I'm good **to** cook" → 错，用 at + doing
`pretty` 在这里是副词「挺、相当」（= quite），不是形容词「漂亮」。口语中 pretty good = 还不错。

items.sentence: I usually go for a run in the morning.
explanations:
`go for a run` = 去跑步（固定搭配）。常见错误：
• "go **to** a run" → 不接 to
• "go **running** a run" → 重复，go running 或 go for a run 二选一
`usually` 频度副词放实义动词前、be 动词后。这里在主语 I 和谓语 go 之间，正确。

sentenceAudio.text: I usually go for a run in the morning.

explanations:
`be into + 名词/动名词` = 对…着迷（口语）。常见错误：
• "I'm **interesting in** cooking" → 用 interested in 或 be into，别混搭
• "I into cooking" → 漏掉 be 动词
表达兴趣爱好三件套：be into / be interested in / enjoy，后接动名词。`these days` = 近来，常与现在时/进行时连用。

items.sentence: May I hand in my homework tomorrow?
explanations:
学生向老师请求用语。`May I` 比 Can I 更正式礼貌。常见错误：
• "May I to hand in" → 情态动词后接原形
• "Can I hand in" → 口语可以，对老师用 May 更得体
`hand in` = 上交（作业）。同义：turn in / submit。
`tomorrow` 作时间副词，不加介词（不说 on tomorrow）。

sentenceAudio.text: May I hand in my homework tomorrow?

items.sentence: I'm having trouble understanding this part.
explanations:
`have trouble doing` = 做…有困难（固定搭配 trouble 后接动名词）。常见错误：
• "have trouble **to** understand" → trouble 后接 doing 不接 to do
• "have troubles" → trouble 此处不可数
`understanding this part` = 理解这部分。part 指课程/材料的某部分。

sentenceAudio.text: I'm having trouble understanding this part.

items.sentence: Could you explain it in a simpler way?
items.translation: 你能用更简单的方式解释吗？
explanations:
请老师换种方式讲解。`explain it` = 解释它（explain 是及物动词，直接接宾语）。常见错误：
• "explain **me** it" → explain 接 explain sth to sb，不接双宾
• "explain it **me**" → 漏了 to：explain it to me
`in a simpler way` = 用更简单的方式。simpler 是 simple 的比较级。

sentenceAudio.text: Could you explain it in a simpler way?

items.sentence: I'll try my best to catch up with the class.
items.translation: 我会尽最大努力赶上班级进度。
explanations:
`try my best` = 尽最大努力。常见错误：
• "try **me** best" → 物主代词 my 对应主语 I
• "do my best" → 同义，try my best 也可

`catch up with` = 赶上（进度/某人）。catch up 后可跟 with + 对象。常见错误：
• "catch up the class" → 需 with：catch up with the class
`the class` 此处指「全班同学/课程进度」。
distractors: to catch the class up with

sentenceAudio.text: I'll try my best to catch up with the class.

items.sentence: I used to play the piano when I was little.
explanations:
`used to do` = 过去常常做（现在不再）。常见错误：
• "I **use** to play" → 表过去习惯用 used to
• "I was used to play" → be used to 后接 doing（习惯做），与 used to do 不同义

`the piano` 弹乐器前要加 the：play the piano / the guitar。常见错误：
• "play piano" → 漏了 the
`when I was little` = 我小时候。little 修饰小时候，也可用 young。

sentenceAudio.text: I used to play the piano when I was little.

explanations:
`get + 形容词` 表「变得」，这里 get 是系动词。常见错误：
• "Did you got taller?" → did 之后用原形 get
• "Did you get tall?" → 跟过去比要用比较级 taller

`taller` 是比较级，隐含「比你以前高」。常见错误：
• "more tall" → 单音节词加 -er
• "tallest" → 最高级用于三者以上

`grow` 表「长身体」时是不及物动词，用进行时表持续变化。常见错误：
• "You growing fast" → 缺 are
• "You are grow fast" → 进行时要用 growing

`fast` 既是形容词也是副词，作副词时不加 -ly。常见错误：
• "growing fastly" → fastly 不存在

`-something` 接在整十数后面，表示「……多岁」，用于说得不精确。常见错误：
• "twenty some" → 要连写成一个词
• "twenty more" → 意思变成「再多二十」
标准书写带连字符：Twenty-something。同义：in my twenties（二十几岁）

`try to do sth` 表「努力做某事」。常见错误：
• "I trying" → 缺 am
• "try studying" → try doing 表「试试看（方法）」，语义不同
进行时表「此刻正在」。同义：I'm studying. / I'm hitting the books.

英语用 be + 时间词表达「某事在某时」。常见错误：
• "My test is in tomorrow" → tomorrow 前不加介词
• "My test are tomorrow" → test 单数用 is
`test` 指考试、测验。同义：I have a test tomorrow.
